symbols.reasoning: Validates cash_in/out, composite type+request replay, positive amount/reason, actor, pretransaction Open shift, permission and day. Selects Main->Drawer for cash_in and Drawer->Main for cash_out. Inside transaction obtains source liquidity lock, reserves journal, posts movement tagged requested shift/day, completes journal/audit/save/commit. Source lock prevents protected overdraft but not stale shift admission: paused cash_in after open check can resume after handover and credit closed shift drawer if Main funded. Day gate likewise pretransaction; treat extension of admission findings until root disposition, not extra counted defect. Rollback/conflict replay handles same key, distinct type with same request intentionally different keys.
